rareearth.problem: Nd and La are hard to separate; China does most of it
rareearth.design: Extractant that picks Nd over La

magrec.problem: Magnet scrap holds Nd and Dy that are rarely recovered
magrec.design: Extractant that pulls Nd from magnet scrap

reecoal.problem: Coal waste holds rare earths at low levels
reecoal.design: Extractant for trace rare earths in coal ash

gallium.problem: China restricts gallium exports; Ga sits at ~200 mg/L in alumina Bayer liquor
gallium.design: Extractant/sorbent that picks gallium from Bayer liquor

germanium.problem: China restricts germanium exports; Ge sits in zinc refinery residues
germanium.design: Extractant that recovers germanium from zinc leach

xenon.problem: Xenon is rare and costly to recover from air
xenon.design: Sorbent that picks xenon over krypton
